//: The tests run against a deployed app server (ui), and snapshot and restore its DB through
the DB dump API of another deployment that manages it (dbAPI).
ui is the rc server: the tests fill its DB with their data. dbAPI is the deployment the rc
belongs to, which the tests only ask for dumps and restores of the rc DB. Do not swap them:
the tests refuse a ui server of the production environment, and the same server in both
// failureDumps: Whether the DB is dumped after a failed test, for you to look at. Such a dump stays on the
dbAPI server until deleted by hand, so on this target it is off if not given.
MEMO_E2E_FAILURE_DUMPS=1 or 0 overrides it for one run.
